title: Gemelar about her knife incident

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: Hey boss. Got a problem with my performance?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey boss. Got a problem with my performance?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What makes you ask that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What makes you ask that?

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: Why else would you be here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why else would you be here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The knife incident?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The knife incident?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe I got an idea for the restaurant?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe I got an idea for the restaurant?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe I got an idea for the restaurant?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe I got an idea for the restaurant?

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: Yeah, right. Nice try.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, right. Nice try.

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: Well, I told you everything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I told you everything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Except which restaurant and which boss it was.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Except which restaurant and which boss it was.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Except which restaurant and which boss it was.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Except which restaurant and which boss it was.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We need to talk about the knife incident...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We need to talk about the knife incident...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We need to talk about the knife incident...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We need to talk about the knife incident...

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: You really need to know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You really need to know?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I looked for reports on the incident and found nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I looked for reports on the incident and found nothing.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I looked for reports on the incident and found nothing.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I looked for reports on the incident and found nothing.

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: Right. It wasn't in Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. It wasn't in Nivalis.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not stupid, Gemelar.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not stupid, Gemelar.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, that explains everything. Back to work then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, that explains everything. Back to work then.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, that explains everything. Back to work then.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, that explains everything. Back to work then.

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: Didn't say you were.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Didn't say you were.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Come on. Level with me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Come on. Level with me.

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: I ... don't need to tell you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I ... don't need to tell you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And I don't need to employ you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And I don't need to employ you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And I don't need to employ you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And I don't need to employ you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I could fire you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I could fire you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well then, you're fired.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well then, you're fired.

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: I still don't want to talk about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I still don't want to talk about it.

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: All you need to know is that I had the knife and I wanted it to happen. I wanted to make sure my old boss didn't do to anyone else what he did to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All you need to know is that I had the knife and I wanted it to happen. I wanted to make sure my old boss didn't do to anyone else what he did to me.

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: The rest is just details. You don't need to know more.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The rest is just details. You don't need to know more.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm your boss so I still need to know the details.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm your boss so I still need to know the details.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm your boss so I still need to know the details.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm your boss so I still need to know the details.

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: What the hell? You're my boss but that's it. You can either let this go or fire me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What the hell? You're my boss but that's it. You can either let this go or fire me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm... sorry. I won't insist.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm... sorry. I won't insist.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can I help you in some way?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I help you in some way?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can I help you in some way?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can I help you in some way?

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: I have people to talk to. And I handled it. So no.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have people to talk to. And I handled it. So no.

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: But... thanks for asking. It's noted, and appreciated.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But... thanks for asking. It's noted, and appreciated.

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: I'm gonna get back to work, but thanks for letting me deal with this on my own.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm gonna get back to work, but thanks for letting me deal with this on my own.

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: You're alright boss. You don't need to worry about me falling apart... or coming at you with a knife.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're alright boss. You don't need to worry about me falling apart... or coming at you with a knife.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright. Let's just forget about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright. Let's just forget about it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Alright. Let's just forget about it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Alright. Let's just forget about it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine, let's drop it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine, let's drop it.

nodes.speaker: Gemelar Eggleston
nodes.text: Always fun to talk boss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Always fun to talk boss.
